questions.query: How do I configure agent API requests, tool calls, output tokens and timeout in the workbench Collaboration preset?
facts: Numeric host controls select request, tool, per-response token and HTTP deadline limits; Start freezes them.
Collaboration preset selects128 requests,256 tools,32768 tokens and180seconds; default12/32/2048/25 remains.

questions.query: Is4096 cells the total agent task quota, or can I edit the whole canvas in repeated batches?
facts: 4096 cells is per observation/edit, not a task total; whole-canvas authority supports repeated batches.
The native owner separately retains64 consumed-proposal receipts across tasks/generations; UI budgets do not raise it.
